releaseNotes:
Is update mein kya naya hai:

1) Har report ab Portrait ya Landscape - Basic Reports aur Accounts Reports ki har report par Orientation ka option, default Portrait. Saath hi report ka font kam se kam 10 kar diya gaya hai taake print saaf parha jaye (10 se bare font waise hi rahenge).

2) Export ka naya button - har report ko ab PDF, Excel ya CSV mein save karein. Excel/CSV report ki poori rows deta hai taake aap khud sort aur pivot kar sakein.

3) Purchase Report mein DisReceivable columns ab optional hain (default off), to Item aur Total columns ko zyada jagah milti hai.

4) Account Ledger par 'All Accounts' - customer + supplier + employee + other, sab ka ledger ek hi PDF mein, Simple ya Detail. Har account naye page par. Kisi account ko select karne ki zaroorat nahi, sirf tareekh chahiye.

5) Backup system behtar:
   - Backup folder ab har computer ka apna hai, to ek machine ka path doosri machines ko nahi torta.
   - Network par agar database doosre computer par ho to app pehle hi bata deti hai ke local drive (jaise I: drive) par backup nahi ho sakta - shared folder chahiye.
   - Backup ke baad SQL Server khud usay verify karta hai.
   - Cloud server par backup ab din mein ek baar, chahe kitne bhi computer khule hon.
   - Naya 'Open Folder' button - seedha backup folder khulta hai aur nayi backup file pehle se select hoti hai.

Update Date: 22-08-2026
